clean.about: A tailored resume and letter for a made-up candidate, written from facts the candidate confirmed.
clean.resume_text:
Alex Rivera | MBA Candidate, Class of 2027 | Boston, MA
Product Manager Intern, Northstar Pay
- Launched a cross-border payment workflow to 700+ live transactions and 1pp higher conversion
- Unlocked funding for a new product by diagnosing a 57% first-transfer drop-off and pricing each recovered point at about $1M a year
- Validated a domestic transfers product with 50 users before writing code
Strategy Consultant, Harbor Advisory
- Moved a national bank from losses to $60M EBITDA by co-leading its turnaround
- Delivered Day 1 of a $3B merger on schedule across 20+ business functions
clean.letter_text:
Dear Hiring Team,
When a customer told me she sends money home on the same day every month, and that one failed transfer means her mother misses rent, I understood what reliability means in payments. That is why I want to build at {employer}.
{employer} wins when a transfer simply arrives. At Northstar Pay I took a new payment workflow to 700+ live transactions, and I found that a 57% first-transfer drop-off was the real problem to fix.
I want ownership of a product that customers notice only when it fails. Thank you for your time and consideration.
Sincerely,
Alex Rivera
